item.tib: rgyas pa kun snang khyab pa rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bka' dbang thugs rje sprin dpung gi lag khrid byin rlabs char 'bebs
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di yang phran nyi ming pas gzhung gi dbur dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha dang sbyar te bshad pa'i rang rang gi thob stang bstun sogs gsungs pa'i dgongs don ci bzhin bsgrigs te sbyar ba dge 'gyur cig/
